name: Famine
value: Risk of Famine in Sudan; none newly confirmed
summary: IPC warns of rising famine risk in Darfur and Kordofan; no area newly classified as Famine as of 25 Nov
state: An IPC alert in October warned of a growing risk of famine in parts of Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan, driven by conflict, displacement, an El Niño drought and funding gaps, but classified no area as Famine (AllAfrica). RSF drone strikes killed up to 19 civilians in Blue Nile on 24 Nov, adding to displacement (Xinhua). Searches on 25 Nov found no new Famine classification, so Watch holds.
for_you: People in Darfur, Kordofan and other conflict zones in Sudan face severe hunger and malnutrition. WFP and the IPC publish the latest assessments.
rubric_hit: Watch: IPC risk-of-famine alert for Darfur and Kordofan; no current Famine (Phase 5) classification found

sources.title: AllAfrica — IPC Sudan Food Insecurity and Malnutrition Alert

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.

rubric.alert: Famine (IPC Phase 5) confirmed in at least one area.
